title: Omuwanguzi Wakati Wa Horizons Bibiri
intro: Mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo by’obulagirizi obw’obwakatonda, ekifaananyi kimu kiyimiridde ku njawulo ng’omufuzi ow’amaanyi era omuddu wa Allah omwetoowaze. Omuntu ono yatambula okutuuka mu bitundu eby’ewala ennyo ku nsi, n’alaba enjuba ng’evaayo ku bantu abatali ba bulijjo n’egwa mu nsulo enjeru eyali efuuse enzikiza. Ekisinga okwewuunyisa, omuweereza ono yaweebwa omulimu gw’okuzimba ekiziyiza eky’ekitalo okulwanyisa eggwanga ery’obugwenyufu obw’amaanyi. Osobola okuzuula omuntu ono ow’olugero okuva mu Quran?
clues: Naweebwa amaanyi n’obuyinza mu nsi Omusaasizi ennyo
Natambula okutuuka mu kifo enjuba w’evaayo n’egwa
Natuuka ku bantu abaali batasobola kutegeera kigambo kyonna
Nnalagirwa okuzimba ekiziyiza ekinene ennyo nga nkozesa ekyuma
Nnasiba ekifo wakati w’ensozi bbiri eziwanvu n’ekyuma ekisaanuuse
Nze saali malayika wadde nnabbi, wabula omuddu Allah gwe yawa ekisa

trial.label: Omulimu Omunene
options: Okuzimba ekiziyiza ekinene eky’ekyuma ekiziyiza Yajuj ne Majuj
Okutonda entebe ya zaabu ey’okusalirwa omusango
Okuzimba emmeeri mu kiseera ky’amataba amangi
trial.answer: Okuzimba ekiziyiza ekinene eky’ekyuma ekiziyiza Yajuj ne Majuj

location.label: Enteekateeka y’Ekifo
options: Ensi ya Uzayiri wakati w’emigga ebiri
Ekifo enjuba w’evaayo n’ensulo y’ebitosi ebiddugavu
location.answer: Ekifo enjuba w’evaayo n’ensulo y’ebitosi ebiddugavu

outcome.label: Ekisuubizo ky’Obwakatonda
options: Ekiziyiza kijja kubeerawo okutuusa ku lunaku lw’enkomerero
Eddembe okuva mu kufa eri abakkiriza bonna
outcome.answer: Ekiziyiza kijja kubeerawo okutuusa ku lunaku lw’enkomerero

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
